supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The ridge extends slightly beyond the outer lateral margins of the eyes.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: The muzzle region exhibits higher pixel intensity (lighter) than the low-intensity (darker) periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Narrow 2D vertical thickness with a slight outward protrusion.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced infraorbital creases and visible nasolabial furrows.
